class _ReverseKL(torch.autograd.Function):
    """Memory-efficient exact reverse KL.

    KL(p_s || p_t) per position, with the closed-form gradient
    d/ds = p_s * ((log p_s - log p_t) - KL) / T recomputed chunk-by-chunk in
    backward, so no fp32 vocab-sized intermediates are retained between the
    forward and backward passes (matters at 250k vocabularies).
    """

    @staticmethod
    def forward(ctx, s: torch.Tensor, t: torch.Tensor, temperature: float, chunk_size: int):
        kls = []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for sc, tc in zip(s.split(chunk_size), t.split(chunk_size)):
                s_lp = F.log_softmax(sc.float() / temperature, dim=-1)
                t_lp = F.log_softmax(tc.float() / temperature, dim=-1)
                kls.append(torch.sum(s_lp.exp() * (s_lp - t_lp), dim=-1))
        kl = torch.cat(kls)
        ctx.save_for_backward(s, t, kl)
        ctx.temperature = temperature
        ctx.chunk_size = chunk_size
        return kl

    @staticmethod
    def backward(ctx, grad_out: torch.Tensor):
        s, t, kl = ctx.saved_tensors
        temperature, chunk_size = ctx.temperature, ctx.chunk_size
        grads = []
        for sc, tc, klc, gc in zip(
            s.split(chunk_size),
            t.split(chunk_size),
            kl.split(chunk_size),
            grad_out.split(chunk_size),
        ):
            s_lp = F.log_softmax(sc.float() / temperature, dim=-1)
            t_lp = F.log_softmax(tc.float() / temperature, dim=-1)
            g = s_lp.exp() * (s_lp - t_lp - klc.unsqueeze(-1)) / temperature
            grads.append((g * gc.unsqueeze(-1)).to(s.dtype))
        return torch.cat(grads), None, None, None
